newsitem.title: USA: Maxco unit sale won't be material.
newsitem.headline: Maxco unit sale won't be material.

text.p: Maxco Inc said Thursday the sale of its Wright Plastic Products Inc unit to a Cleveland-based company would result in no material gain or loss.
The buyer was privately held Plastic Acquisition Co LLC, which will continue to operate as Wright Plastic Products. The assets totaling about $10 million were purchased for cash.
Part of the proceeds from the transaction went toward retiring about $2.5 million of long-term debt.
Sheridan, Mich.-based Wright Plastic Products posted an operating loss on revenues of about $17 million in the fiscal year ended March 31, 1996.
It represented about 13 percent of the company's assets and accounted for about 21 percent of Maxco's $80.2 million of consolidated net sales from continuing operations in fiscal 1996.
Following the sale of Wright Plastic Products, Maxco said it expects to post net sales from continuing operations of about $70 million for the year ending March 31, 1997.
Last week, Maxco said it was in exclusive financial discussions on the possible acquisition of Lansing-based Atmosphere Annealing Inc which provides metal heat treating for industrial users.
Maxco said talks are in a preliminary stage, and the company will make an offer only if it determines that the acquisition would enhance its shareholder value.
If the purchase goes forward, Maxco will have achieved most of its planned reorganizational moves which began with the sale of FinishMaster Inc in July 1996.

The FinishMaster sale allowed Maxco to retire $21.3 million of bank debt and repurchase over 600,000 shares of Maxco common stock. These completed and proposed moves would leave Maxco with a base of business with total annual sales of about $100 million in the service and wholesale distribution area, along with investments in real estate and a 20 percent share in Medar Inc. -- Chicago newsdesk 312 408-8787
